nodes.question: How do large language models (LLMs) impact knowledge creation, according to the research presented?
nodes.answer: LLMs can promote knowledge creation if used well, but they also pose risks by producing texts that users may not perceive as sources of knowledge, which could lead individuals to retreat into ignorance.
